One natural pattern is to repeatedly divide by 2 and keep the result as an integer by rounding down (equivalently, arithmetic right-shift/floor division):

- \(-8 \div 2 = -4\)
- \(-4 \div 2 = -2\)
- \(-2 \div 2 = -1\)
- \(-1 \div 2 = -0.5\), which floors to \(-1\)

After that, it stays \(-1\).
